verdict.rationale: Twilio documents an official MCP server at /docs/ai/mcp that gives AI coding agents structured access to over 1,800 endpoints across 30+ products, and a probe confirms the page exists. The server indexes only public API specifications and needs no account or keys, so it appears to serve reference material rather than act on a user's Twilio account. missing for 10: evidence of authenticated, account-acting tool calls, documented client setup/config details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
